name: create_issues
description: Creates one issue per title, for example from meeting notes or a list of action items.

arguments.name: titles
arguments.description: One title per issue to create.

arguments.name: body
arguments.description: Description added to every created issue.

arguments.name: labels
arguments.description: Labels to put on the new issues.

arguments.name: assignees
arguments.description: Logins to assign the new issues to. "@me" means the current user.

arguments.name: milestone_number
arguments.description: Milestone to put the new issues in.

examples: Turn these meeting notes into issues
Create issues for each action item
File a bug for the broken login page
